headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to hire more people with disabilities.
what_it_does: This executive order focuses on increasing the number of people with disabilities who work for the federal government. Based on the title, it directs federal agencies to take steps to hire and employ more individuals with disabilities. No summary was provided, so specific requirements, goals, or programs are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People with disabilities seeking federal jobs
who_it_affects.how: They may see more efforts by federal agencies to recruit and hire them.
They are directed to work toward employing more individuals with disabilities.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 26, 2010; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless stated otherwise.
